cards.sig: when did you last go to the cinema / the movies? 1 go to the cinema / the movies or: when was the last time you went to the cinema / the movies? did you last go · the last time you went ✗ when did you go to the cinema last time? the answer: two weeks ago · last month — or: i haven't been for ages! not sure? i can't remember exactly — in the summer, maybe? + one detail: what did you see? was it good?

when did you last solve an equation? 2 solve an equation or: when was the last time you solved an equation? the answer: at school · ages ago — or: last week, helping my kid with their homework! not sure? i can't remember exactly — in my last year at school, maybe? + one detail: was it for you or for your kids?

when did you last cook for friends? 3 cook for friends or: when was the last time you cooked for friends? the answer: last weekend · a month ago — or: i haven't done that for ages! not sure? i can't remember exactly — on my birthday, maybe? + one detail: what did you make?

when did you last climb a tree? 4 climb a tree or: when was the last time you climbed a tree? ✗ when did you climb a tree last time? the answer: as a kid · ages ago — or: last summer, with my kids! not sure? i can't remember exactly — at 12, maybe? + one detail: where was it? did you get down ok?

when did you last go to a concert? 5 go to a concert or: when was the last time you went to a concert? the answer: last spring · a few years ago — or: i haven't been to one for ages! not sure? i can't remember exactly — two years ago, maybe? + one detail: who did you see?

when did you last build a snowman? 6 build a snowman or: when was the last time you built a snowman? the answer: last winter · as a kid · ages ago not sure? i can't remember exactly — a few years ago, maybe? + one detail: where? who with?

when did you last stay up really late? 7 stay up really late or: when was the last time you stayed up really late? the answer: last night! · on saturday · on new year's eve + one detail: why? what were you doing?

when did you last go camping? 8 go camping or: when was the last time you went camping? did you last go · the last time you went the answer: in my early twenties · a few years ago — or: i haven't been for ages! never? i've never been camping! not sure? i can't remember exactly — at 18, maybe? + one detail: where? did it rain?

when did you last go to a wedding? 9 go to a wedding or: when was the last time you went to a wedding? ✗ when did you go to a wedding last time? the answer: last summer · a few years ago — or: i haven't been to one for ages! not sure? i can't remember exactly — three years ago, maybe? + one detail: whose wedding was it? was it fun?

when did you last go on a rollercoaster? 10 go on a rollercoaster or: when was the last time you went on a rollercoaster? the answer: last summer · as a kid · ages ago — or: i haven't been on one for ages! never? i've never been on one! not sure? i can't remember exactly — five years ago, maybe? + one detail: where? was it fun — or a bit too scary?
when did you last lose your keys? 11 lose your keys or: when was the last time you lost your keys? the answer: last week · a few months ago · ages ago + one detail: where were they in the end?

when did you last take an exam? 12 take an exam or: when was the last time you took an exam? сдавать экзамен = take an exam · сдать = pass an exam the answer: at university / in college · in my mid-twenties · last year not sure? i can't remember exactly — three years ago, maybe? + one detail: what was it? did you pass?

when did you last have a proper holiday / a real vacation? 13 have a proper holiday / a real vacation or: when was the last time you had a proper holiday / a real vacation? ✗ when did you have a proper holiday last time? the answer: in the summer · last year — or: i haven't had one for ages! not sure? i can't remember exactly — two years ago, maybe? + one detail: where did you go?

when did you last send a postcard? 14 send a postcard or: when was the last time you sent a postcard? the answer: ages ago · as a kid — or: i haven't done that for ages! not sure? i can't remember exactly — ten years ago, maybe? + one detail: who to? where from?

when did you last buy something you didn't really need? 15 buy something you didn't really need or: when was the last time you bought something you didn't really need? the answer: yesterday · last week · last month + one detail: what was it? do you actually use it?

when did you last ride a bike? 16 ride a bike or: when was the last time you rode a bike? ride → rode ✗ when did you ride a bike last time? the answer: last weekend · last summer · as a kid not sure? i can't remember exactly — two years ago, maybe? + one detail: where did you go?

questions.0.sig: 1 what has ben done since he retired? name three things.
2 why does ben go to starbucks every morning?
3 what's the nowhere-to-be thing? explain it in your own words.

questions.1.sig: ben 1 “i'm not an unhappy person,” ben says. do you believe him? what in the video makes you say that?
ben 2 which of the things in the box bother ben? which would bother you most, and which wouldn't bother you at all?
you 3 what do you do when you've got time on your hands?
you 4 name two moments in life when people get that nowhere-to-be feeling (after a long trip, at the end of a big project…). what helps?

questions.6.sig: from memory: what did ben do at first, and what happened every time he got home? use two phrases from part 1.

questions.11.sig: ben goes to starbucks to feel part of something. name two places where people can feel part of something. which one works — or would work — for you?

questions.16.sig: ben's at starbucks every morning these days. what do you do these days that you didn't do a year ago? name two things.

questions.22.sig: 1 ben says he probably relied on his son's family “way more than he should”. why do you think he feels that way?
2 “get up, get out of the house and go somewhere.” does it work for ben? would it work for you? why or why not?
3 ben has tried yoga, cooking and mandarin. name two things you've tried — or would like to try — in your free time, and one you'd never try (again).
4 ben says there's a hole in his life. name two things that could fill it — and one that wouldn't.

questions.38.sig: 1 tell ben's story in two sentences: how it all started, and where he is now.
2 name two things you rely on more than you should (your phone? coffee? your car?). start: don't get me wrong, i love…, but…

questions.39.sig: 1 tell your partner about something new in your life: a job, a hobby, a routine… — or take one from the stories. your partner asks first: so what was it like at first? or how's it going so far? tell them how it started and how it's going now. then swap.
2 now another one — this time your partner asks the other question first.
